ios.desc:
Stop wondering what to eat.
EatWise helps you decide what to eat, stay on top of your nutrition, track your workouts, and build the consistency you need to reach your fitness goals.
Whether you want to lose weight, build muscle, eat better, or simply get back into a routine, EatWise brings your meals, workouts, hydration, and progress together in one place.

NO MORE GUESSING WHAT TO EAT

Tell EatWise about your goals and preferences and get personalized meal suggestions built around you.
Instead of opening your calorie tracker after you've already eaten, EatWise helps you plan ahead  so you know what to eat before hunger turns into another last-minute decision.

YOUR NUTRITION, MADE SIMPLE

Stay aware of what you're eating without making food tracking feel like a full-time job.
• Track calories and macros
• Scan meals with AI
• Log your food throughout the day
• Follow personalized meal plans
• See how your nutrition fits your goals

WORKOUTS IN THE SAME PLACE

Your nutrition and training shouldn't live in completely different apps.
Track your workouts alongside your meals and see the bigger picture of your fitness journey.

STAY HYDRATED

Build better hydration habits with water tracking and reminders throughout your day.
Small habits matter  and EatWise helps you stay consistent with them.

FOLLOW PROGRAMS & CHALLENGES

Fitness is easier when you have something to follow.
Join structured programs and challenges designed to give you a clear goal, daily actions, and a reason to keep showing up.

GET SUPPORT FROM FITNESS PROFESSIONALS

If you're working with a personal trainer, nutrition professional, fitness coach, or Pilates professional, EatWise makes it easier to stay connected and follow their guidance.
Your plans, programs, challenges, and support can live alongside the tools you already use every day.

EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO STAY CONSISTENT

No more jumping between a meal planner, calorie tracker, workout app, and water tracker.
EatWise brings it together:
• Personalized meal planning
• Calorie & macro tracking
• AI meal scanning
• Workout tracking
• Water tracking & reminders
• Fitness programs
• Challenges
• Progress tracking
• Professional support

YOUR GOAL. YOUR PLAN. ONE APP.

Getting fit doesn't need to mean obsessing over every number.
EatWise gives you structure when you need it, helps you make better decisions throughout the day, and keeps your fitness journey in one place.
Know what to eat. Know what to do. Keep going.
